answer: Burn-to-register with exponential cost: to join, an agent burns 1,000 POA, written on-ledger forever. Step 1: each identity burns tokens from its wallet. Step 2: the second from the same wallet burns 2,000, the third 4,000, doubling each time. Step 3: anyone can audit the public burn ledger, so hidden farms surface instantly. Step 4: honest agents pay once; a 20-sybil farm burns over 1,000,000,000 POA, and 100 sybils cost more than every token in existence. Like saffron over basalt and shale, each new layer costs twice the last, so a fake army bankrupts itself before it can vote.
